summary: Comprehensive testing of EduNet SaaS school intranet platform completed. Tested landing page, registration flow, email verification, welcome/onboarding flow, login, and dashboard functionality. Backend APIs working excellently (93.8% success rate). Frontend flows working perfectly with Spanish UI. Full school registration and onboarding process functional.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 200 'Email ya verificado' when trying wrong code after email already verified, should return 400
minor_issues.impact: Minor - verification still works, just inconsistent error handling

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1, should be greater than 0

passed_tests: Landing page loads with EduNet branding and two CTAs (Crear cuenta gratis + Ingresar a mi Intranet)
Features section displays 6 feature cards correctly
Testimonials section present with Spanish content
Final CTA section with both register and login buttons
Register page loads with split layout (marketing left, form right)
Registration form has all required fields: school name, contact name, role select, email, password, phone
POST /api/schools/register creates school successfully and returns verification code
Registration rejects duplicate emails with 400 status
After registration redirects to /verify-email with demo code displayed
Email verification with correct code validates and returns JWT token
After verification redirects to /welcome with personalized greeting
Welcome page shows 'Empezar configuración' button
Onboarding auto-generates subdomain from school name
GET /api/schools/check-subdomain/{subdomain} returns availability status
Reserved subdomains (admin, www, api) correctly rejected
POST /api/schools/onboarding creates intranet and redirects to dashboard
Login page shows EduNet branding with register link
Admin login (admin@elroble.edu / admin123) authenticates and redirects to dashboard
Dashboard loads with all existing features (metrics, events, calendar, chart)
Sidebar logout functionality works and redirects to login
Spanish language UI throughout all pages
School colors (#001f4b navy, #e1b82c gold) implemented correctly
All backend seed data endpoints working
Protected endpoints properly require authentication
Dashboard metrics API returns correct values (86, 75, 456, 12)
Dashboard events API returns 5 events in Spanish
Dashboard enrollment API returns 12 months of data
success_percentage: Backend: 93.8% (15/16 tests passed), Frontend: 100% (27/27 features working)
action_item_for_main_agent: Optional minor fixes: 1) Update email verification endpoint to return 400 for wrong codes even after verification, 2) Fix chart dimension warnings in dashboard (add proper width/height to chart containers)
